sections.heading: Tirhut Milk Union: Muzaffarpur's Sudha Dairy
paragraphs: Muzaffarpur is the base of the Tirhut Milk Union (TIMUL), a district union of the Bihar State Milk Co-operative Federation (COMFED), whose area covers Muzaffarpur, Sitamarhi, Sheohar, East Champaran (Motihari), Chakia, West Champaran, Siwan and Gopalganj. COMFED was founded in 1983 and sells under the Sudha brand.

When Sudha took its range to Guwahati in 2018 it listed pouch milk in two variants, curd, paneer, lassi, chhach, peda, mishti doi and cream, so cultured and sweetened products run alongside liquid milk across the federation.

sections.heading: Expansion of the Muzaffarpur Dairy and Bihar's COMFED Network
paragraphs: In May 2011 Biharprabha reported that COMFED ran 14 dairies producing 14 lakh litres a day against a target of 22 lakh, with the Muzaffarpur dairy planned to grow from 1.5 to 2.5 lakh litres a day and Samastipur from 2.5 to 5 lakh. New dairies were planned at Biharsharif for 4 lakh litres, Dehri-On-Sone for 1 lakh and Jamui for 10,000 litres a day.

Later growth is recorded on Wikipedia: the Nalanda dairy opened in 2013 as the largest automation-based dairy plant in eastern India, a 5 lakh litre a day dairy and a 300 MT a day fodder plant were started at Bihian in 2020, and in January 2021 two plants of 2 lakh litres a day each were due at Bhagalpur and Purnia, with Rs 53 crore of Rs 234 crore released as a first instalment. Those 2011 numbers were targets at the time of the report, so a project team should confirm the current capacity of the Muzaffarpur plant with the union before sizing new lines.

sections.heading: Matching Tube Finish to Muzaffarpur Product Lines
paragraphs: Curd, lassi, chhach, mishti doi, paneer and peda processing all deposit protein or caramelised solids on the tube wall, so for those sections we advise 316L to ASTM A270 with an SF4 electropolished bore. With each electropolished lot we provide an Ra report and an EN 10204 3.1 certificate that is traced to the heat number.

Milk reception from village societies, chilling and pouch-milk transfer, chilled water and CIP return lines are generally fine in 304L with an SF1 or mill finish, which keeps a north Bihar dairy upgrade economical.

sections.heading: What to Send With a Muzaffarpur Enquiry
bullets: Section the tube is for: reception, pouch milk, curd and lassi, paneer, sweets or CIP
Size list giving OD, wall and metres for each diameter
Required grade and bore, 316L SF4 for cultured lines or 304L SF1 or mill finish elsewhere
Standard to supply against, ASTM A270, A269 or ASME BPE, and any Ra upper limit
Matching ferrules, bends, tees or reducers if you want one combined price

sections.heading: Delivery to Muzaffarpur and North Bihar
paragraphs: Consignments bound for Muzaffarpur move by road out of Mumbai, every electropolished length end-capped and wrapped in a sleeve, with the dispatch date and transit confirmed to you in writing at the order stage. Every length passes PMI before loading, and when an enquiry has all its details you will have our quotation within 24 hours.
